verdict.rationale: ReelMimic's main workflow runs on natural language. Users tell it what to make alongside a reference [reelmimic-docs-1, reelmimic-gh-10]. They then chat about the storyboard plan until they approve it [reelmimic-docs-3], request changes in the chat panel, screenshots included [reelmimic-gh-1], and type timestamped notes on the finished video [reelmimic-docs-7]. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is first-party README), and natural-language control of secondary operations such as publishing and setup, which use CLI flags and env vars instead [reelmimic-gh-9, reelmimic-gh-6].
